NP Presspad 1.2.5 — Draft dates stop freezing

A fix for draft dates in WordPress. **No companion plugin update needed.**

## Drafts

- Editing a draft now updates its date in WordPress again, so drafts stay ordered by how recently you worked on them.
- Previously the app sent a date with every push. For a draft that told WordPress the date had been set deliberately, which permanently switched off the rule that moves an unpublished post's date forward each time it is saved. Once a draft had been pushed, its date never moved again — not even when edited in WordPress directly.
- The same freeze also meant a draft published later kept its old date instead of taking the time it was published. That stops too.
- Published and scheduled posts are unaffected: their date is the publish date, chosen by you, and is still sent as before.

Drafts already frozen by an earlier version keep their stale date until corrected on the site itself — the app can no longer cause it, but it cannot undo it either.
